raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Enable DeepSeek-V4.1 image inputs with Model Runner V2 PCP on NVIDIA GPUs, including fixed-length DSpark.

## Claims

- Use the existing encoder cache and PCP segment mapping for image inputs.
- Skip empty PCP windows so idle ranks do not request invalid image slices.

## Validation

H20 integration checks with TP1 × PCP4 and DSpark 5:

| Configuration | Image/text cases | C32/C64 cold/warm stress |
|---|---:|---|
| TP1 × PCP4, NONE | 33/33 | Not run |
| TP1 × PCP4, FULL_DECODE_ONLY | 33/33 | Not run |
| TP1 × PCP4, FULL_AND_PIECEWISE | 33/33 | Passed |

Full GSM8K on TP1 × PCP4: **1229/1319 (93.18%)**. Both extraction filters were independently rescored from all saved responses, with no preemptions. The 33 image/text cases are bounded diagnostics, not a broad visual evaluation.

<details>
<summary>Tests and validation limits</summary>

Pure-source unit suites passed **28 encoder + 9 PCP checks**; integration suites passed **12 Engram + 9 PCP + 33 indexer checks**. Ruff, mypy, and applicable local checks pass. Full pre-commit bootstrap remains incomplete because of GitHub fetch timeouts.

The existing four-B200 nightly adds one TP2 × PCP2 test for image chunking, cached image/text batches, and DSpark 5, requiring nonzero draft acceptance on image-only and mixed requests. **This exact nightly has not run.**

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/v1/worker/test_encoder_runner.py
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_pcp_manager.py -k test_validate_config
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -v -s tests/distributed/test_deepseek_v41_multimodal_pcp.py
```

GPU runs reuse a pinned precompiled native runtime. Strict `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` encounters synchronization in the unchanged vision span helper; a CUDA reproducer without PCP confirms the same issue.

</details>

## Details

ViT remains replicated. PCP partitions the language-model sequence; DSpark consumes the target's image-conditioned auxiliary hidden states. Existing model restrictions still apply.

CUDA graph integration uses [#61555](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61555); the TP1 × PCP4 validation also uses shared Engram from [#61554](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61554). Those changes are separate from this PR.

Scoped open-PR searches found no duplicate: [#62802](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62802) concerns encoder disaggregation and [#43580](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/43580) Qwen ViT parallelism.

AI assisted implementation, review, and test preparation.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

@@ -16,6 +16,29 @@ Depending on the use case, there are two possible strategies:
 
 Both approaches are under active development.
 
+### DeepSeek-V4.1 image inputs
+
+On NVIDIA GPUs, DeepSeek-V4.1 supports image inputs with Model Runner V2 PCP.
+Enable PCP with `--prefill-context-parallel-size`. For eager execution, use
+`--enforce-eager`. Leave
+`--language-model-only` disabled and allow the required number of images with
+`--limit-mm-per-prompt`, for example `'{"image": 2}'`.
+
+The vision encoder runs within each PCP replica. PCP partitions the language
+model's sequence, including image embeddings, and each rank consumes the
+embeddings belonging to its local token segments. This does not partition a
+single image's vision attention across PCP ranks.
+
+Fixed-length DSpark is supported, for example
+`--speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5}'`.
+The draft receives image context through the target model's auxiliary hidden
+states. CUDA graph modes remain subject to the model's existing PCP support.
+
+This image-input path requires PP=DP=DCP=1. The existing DeepSeek-V4.1 PCP
+restrictions on adaptive verification, microbatching, KV transfer and MegaMoE
+still apply. Prefix caching requires
+`--swa-bounded-replay`. Other multimodal models remain unsupported by PCP.
+
 ## Decode Context Parallel
 
 Due to the auto-regressive nature of decoding, every decoding step needs to compute a small amount of query tokens w.r.t. a large number of key/value tokens stored in the paged KV cache. The core of decode context parallel is how to shard the KV cache across GPUs.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Real-weight image PCP regression, selected by the four-GPU PCP nightly."""
+
+import pytest
+import regex as re
+
+from vllm import SamplingParams
+from vllm.multimodal.utils import encode_image_url
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.renderers.chat_utils import ChatCompletionMessageParam
+
+from ..conftest import ImageTestAssets, VllmRunner
+from ..models.registry import HF_EXAMPLE_MODELS
+from ..v1.e2e.spec_decode.utils import compute_acceptance_rate
+
+
+@pytest.mark.distributed(num_gpus=4)
+def test_deepseek_v41_image_pcp(
+    vllm_runner: type[VllmRunner], image_assets: ImageTestAssets, monkeypatch
+):
+    """Draft from image context across PCP chunks and cached mixed batches."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "1")
+    model = HF_EXAMPLE_MODELS.get_hf_info("DeepseekV41ForCausalLM").default
+    image_chat: list[ChatCompletionMessageParam] = [
+        {
+            "role": "user",
+            "content": [
+                {
+                    "type": "image_url",
+                    "image_url": {"url": encode_image_url(image_assets[0].pil_image)},
+                },
+                {
+                    "type": "text",
+                    "text": "Read the prominent English text in the image and "
+                    "explain its meaning in one sentence.",
+                },
+            ],
+        }
+    ]
+    sampling = SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_tokens=32)
+    with vllm_runner(
+        model,
+        tokenizer_mode="deepseek_v41",
+        tensor_parallel_size=2,
+        prefill_context_parallel_size=2,
+        enable_expert_parallel=True,
+        enforce_eager=True,
+        compilation_config={"mode": 0, "cudagraph_mode": "NONE"},
+        speculative_config={"method": "dspark", "num_speculative_tokens": 5},
+        async_scheduling=False,
+        disable_log_stats=False,
+        attention_backend="FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41",
+        moe_backend="humming",
+        kv_cache_dtype="fp8_ds_mla",
+        block_size=64 if current_platform.is_device_capability_family(90) else 128,
+        max_model_len=4096,
+        max_num_batched_tokens=128,
+        max_num_seqs=2,
+        enable_chunked_prefill=True,
+        enable_prefix_caching=True,
+        swa_bounded_replay=True,
+        disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager=False,
+        limit_mm_per_prompt={"image": 1},
+    ) as runner:
+        cold = runner.llm.chat(
+            image_chat, sampling, chat_template_kwargs={"thinking": False}
+        )[0]
+        assert cold.finished
+        assert cold.outputs[0].finish_reason in ("stop", "length")
+        assert cold.prompt_token_ids is not None
+        assert cold.prompt_token_ids.count(129264) > 128
+        assert re.search(r"\bstop\b", cold.outputs[0].text, re.IGNORECASE)
+        cold_metrics = runner.llm.get_metrics()
+        assert compute_acceptance_rate(cold_metrics) > 0
+
+        mixed = runner.llm.chat(
+            [
+                image_chat,
+                [{"role": "user", "content": "What is 2 + 2? Reply with one digit."}],
+            ],
+            sampling,
+            chat_template_kwargs={"thinking": False},
+        )
+        assert all(output.finished for output in mixed)
+        assert all(
+            output.outputs[0].finish_reason in ("stop", "length") for output in mixed
+        )
+        assert re.search(r"\bstop\b", mixed[0].outputs[0].text, re.IGNORECASE)
+        assert re.search(r"\b4\b", mixed[1].outputs[0].text)
+        assert mixed[0].num_cached_tokens is not None
+        assert mixed[0].num_cached_tokens > 0
+        assert compute_acceptance_rate(runner.llm.get_metrics(), cold_metrics) > 0
